page.overview:
Who is Witch?

Splash Potion of Poison per 1.25 sec for 45 sec () Splash Potion of Slowness:

Height: 1.95 blocksWidth: 0.6 blocks: Height: 1.9 blocksWidth: 0.6 blocks

The witch is a hostile mob that uses potions in combat, both in the form of weapons as splash potions and in the form of drinkable potions for defense.

Witches may spawn in the Overworld above opaque blocks at a light level of 0, in all biomes except mushroom fields and deep dark. Every swamp hut spawns a witch and a cat inside during world generation both which never despawn. Otherwise, witches spawn in the hut. , only witches spawn in the 7×7×9 volume that is the hut, which is the size of the roof and one block over the porch, from one level below the floor of the hut to two blocks above the roof. , the hut has a hardcoded spawn spot on which witches spawn: the spawn spot is the same for every hut.
